articles.title: Bybit challenges Wall Street with a massive push into tokenized U.S. stock IPOs
articles.snippet: Retail investors can now buy shares at official underwritten prices through the crypto exchange, bypassing Wall Street’s exclusive pre-IPO clubs.

articles.title: Bybit to offer tokenized SpaceX IPO access through xStocks
articles.snippet: Eligible Bybit users can subscribe to tokenized SpaceX IPO shares through xStocks, a Kraken-linked framework that brings public market offerings to crypto exchanges.

articles.title: Kraken offers SpaceX IPO access through xStocks
articles.snippet: Eligible users in more than 110 markets can register for tokenized SpaceX equity ahead of the company's highly anticipated public listing.

articles.title: Claude Code Vulnerability Could Let Attackers Steal Credentials From GitHub, Says Microsoft
articles.snippet: Researchers say prompt injection attacks could manipulate AI coding agents to access sensitive credentials stored in software development pipelines.

articles.title: Anthropic Is Helping the NSA Hack China. It Also Wants Everyone to Pause AI
articles.snippet: The company behind Claude embedded engineers at the NSA for offensive cyber ops, then published a report warning AI could soon build itself without humans in the loop.
